name: Crepuscular
author: kolache
description: A night-sea almanac: hooded figures keep a vigil on a cliff under a small, watchful moon. On a closer look they are having pancakes, and the dark around the moon has ears. Messages run down one ruled ledger column with bitten moon-phase marks in the margin.

credits.what: Moon phases, crop marks, top bar, weather particles (code-drawn)
